tokenizers.scope: Conservative license superset from the exact 0.23.1 bindings/python/Cargo.lock for the reviewed Windows x86_64, Linux x86_64 and macOS ARM64 wheels. Workspace tokenizers and tokenizers-python use the repository Apache license. Retained license alternatives do not change OR into AND obligations.
tokenizers.target_evidence: The retained set follows the complete exact-version Cargo.lock, including target-conditional packages, so its license texts cover the three admitted native wheel targets without treating an inactive branch as linked code. Exact getrandom 0.3.4 and 0.4.2 Cargo.toml select r-efi only for target_os=uefi; wasip3 is wasm32+wasi+p3; wasm-bindgen 0.2.118 is wasm32-only. Archive checksums match Cargo.lock. Other targets remain unreviewed and fail closed.
